scripts.clean:all: turbo run clean && rimraf node_modules pnpm-lock.yaml .turbo coverage out
scripts.clean: turbo run clean && rimraf node_modules .turbo coverage out
scripts.deploy: echo 'Name an environment: pnpm deploy:staging or pnpm deploy:prod. There is no environment-less deploy - it built workers that shadowed the real ones.' && exit 1
scripts.deploy:web:staging: pnpm --filter @onlooker/web build:staging && pnpm --filter @onlooker/web exec wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:web:prod: pnpm --filter @onlooker/web build && pnpm --filter @onlooker/web exec wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.migrate:staging: pnpm --filter @onlooker/api exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env staging --remote
scripts.migrate:prod: pnpm --filter @onlooker/api exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env production --remote
scripts.db:backup: pnpm --filter @onlooker/api exec wrangler d1 export DB --env production --remote --output ../../backup_$(date +%s).sql
